description:
If goods shall be shipped, the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping. 
If you have large amounts, special shipping will be necessary. 
In these cases the secretary invites three logistic companies to make offers and she selects one of them. 
In case of small amounts, normal post shipment is used. 
Therefore a package label is written by the secretary and a parcel insurance taken by the logistics department head if necessary. 
In the meantime the goods can be already packaged by the warehousemen. 
If everything is ready, the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the logistic company.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Ship goods" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_GoodsToShip" name="Goods shall be shipped"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipping" name="Secretary clarifies who will do the shipping"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCompany" name="Secretary selects one logistics company"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPost" name="Use normal post shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TransportMerge" name="Shipping method selected" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_LabelInsuranceSplit" name="Prepare label and assess insurance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteLabel" name="Secretary writes a package label"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AllReady" name="Packaging and shipping arrangements ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_GoodsToShip" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipping" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelStart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Gateway_Amount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountIsLarge</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_TransportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_NormalPost">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">amountIsSmall</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="Gateway_TransportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_TransportMerge" targetRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceSplit" targetRef="Task_WriteLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceNecessary" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insuranceIsNecessary</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceNecessary" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insuranceIsNotNecessary</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" targetRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_WriteLabel" targetRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_LabelInsuranceJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AllReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_AllReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_AllReady" targetRef="Task_PreparePickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_PreparePickup" targetRef="End_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitation" name="Invitation to make an offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Shipping offers"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Shipping">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ShippingProcess" name="Shipping process" processRef="Process_Shipping"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsCompanies" name="Three logistics companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Invitation" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsCompanies" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticsCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
